title: Ashes of the Walls
tagline: You were born behind the walls. You will die for what lies beyond them.

bloodlines.name: Common Eldian
bloodlines.text: No penalties and no surprises. The best way to learn the world on a first playthrough.

bloodlines.name: Ackerman-blooded
bloodlines.text: Something old sleeps in your blood. Later, it wakes as a huge burst of speed and strength, and you carry heavier trauma and stress for it.

bloodlines.name: Scholar's child
bloodlines.text: Slower in combat at the start, but you unlock research, tactics and the highest Command potential.

difficulties.name: Cadet
difficulties.text: A gentler road. More supplies, forgiving enemies.

difficulties.name: Soldier
difficulties.text: The intended experience. Scarce gas, real consequences.

difficulties.name: Veteran
difficulties.text: Named allies who fall stay dead.

difficulties.name: Legend
difficulties.text: One life per chapter. Fail and the chapter starts over.

tips: Gas is life. Spend it on movement, not on show.
A dull blade is a dead soldier. Know your count before you jump.
Titans are slow to read and deadly up close. Never fight one you cannot leave.
Your Anchor remembers what you choose.
Canon events always happen. Your place in them does not.
